{{Recipe summary
| Category = Soup recipes
| Servings = 4–6
}}

{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Vegan cuisine|Vegan Cuisine]]

==Ingredients==
*2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] dried [[cookbook:Black Bean|black beans]]
*8 cups [[cookbook:water|water]]
*4 cloves [[cookbook:garlic|garlic]], [[Cookbook:Mincing|minced]]
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]] [[cookbook:Onion|white onion]]
*¼ cup [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]] [[cookbook:Green onion|green onion]]
*2 whole [[cookbook:clove|cloves]]
*½ [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|teaspoon]] ground [[cookbook:cumin|cumin]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoon]] caribe or another ground [[cookbook:Chili Pepper|hot pepper]]
*Juice of 1 [[cookbook:lime|lime]]
*[[cookbook:salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[cookbook:pepper|Pepper]] to taste

==Procedure==
# Place beans in a large pan and cover with water. Bring to a [[cookbook:boil|boil]] and remove from heat. Cover and let stand for 1 hour. [[cookbook:Simmer|Simmer]] for 2 hours and drain.
# Place beans in a large pan and add 8 cups water, garlic, salt, white onions, cumin, ground chili and lime juice. Tie cloves in [[Cookbook:Cheesecloth|cheesecloth]] for easy removal if desired. Bring to a boil; reduce heat, cover and simmer for 2 hours or until beans are tender and soup is thick.
# Mix in green onions and serve with lime wedge.
